Type: sofa
Name: Rivet Fold Modern Ottoman Sofa Bed, 48"W, Dark Grey
Colors: Dark Grey
Materials: Wood
This contemporary yet classic piece will blend in nicely with your existing style while giving you extra seating and a place to rest your feet. Plus, fold back the top and find a handy twin pull-out bed perfect for surprise visitors. 48"W x 29.9"D x 16.5"H Wood frame and solid beech legs Contemporary and comfortable A cozy addition anywhere you need an extra seat or pull out bed for guests Simple assembly; just attach legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
